headline: Trump South Carolina rally remarks
dek: Trump: 'I have settled eight wars or situations that were about to turn into wars. Now we are close to ending two more wars — the conflict between Russia and Ukraine and the war with Iran.
sources: Donald Trump on-record remarks, South Carolina; relayed by APA, Asianet/newsable, NDTV
fault_line: Deal-maker on the verge of two peace deals — or an empty victory lap while the strikes continue? ('They will end one way or another' reads as both promise and threat.)

sections.what_happened: Trump: 'I have settled eight wars or situations that were about to turn into wars. Now we are close to ending two more wars — the conflict between Russia and Ukraine and the war with Iran. They will end one way or another.' On sanctions: 'we're negotiating with Russia right now on Ukraine. We are maybe close to a deal. When you're close to a deal and you have very delicate negotiations, you don't put sanctions on.' On Iran/Russia: 'we have decimated Iran. Russia has had very little input into Iran.' No terms or timing given. NOTE: clashes with Witkoff-Putin readout same day — Putin offered to help on Iran, called Tehran 'our strategic partner' (Ushakov); and with Putin's stated non-negotiables (full Donetsk control, no NATO for Kyiv).
sections.what_verified: APA carries the full 'two more wars' quote; Asianet/newsable relays the sanctions-delay rationale ('maybe close to a deal'); NDTV confirms sanctions-hold line. Quotes are on-record.
sections.what_disputed: Reuters via ET: Putin shows 'few signs of compromising on central war aims' (full Donetsk, no NATO for Kyiv, overall peace deal not ceasefire). Trump's 'settled eight wars' and 'decimated Iran' are rhetoric, not verified counts. Kyiv allies concerned US is withholding intel and hobbling Ukrainian comms (Reuters).
sections.why_matters: The threat inside the promise: 'they will end one way or another' — paired with the NYT-reported fresh strike plans from the 07:00 scan, Trump's 'close to ending' is the diplomacy-track quote AND the strike-track warning in one line. Carry both.
sections.context: Background: Trump South Carolina rally remarks: 'close to ending two more wars' (Ukraine + Iran), 'they will end one way or another'; holds new Russia sanctions during 'delicate negotiations'

totw_analysis: Our read: The threat inside the promise: 'they will end one way or another' — paired with the NYT-reported fresh strike plans from the 07:00 scan, Trump's 'close to ending' is the diplomacy-track quote AND the strike-track warning in one line. Carry both. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deal-maker on the verge of two peace deals — or an empty victory lap while the strikes continue? ('They will end one way or another' reads as both promise and threat.)
